title: Video kiosk catalog
description: Folders and videos that the video kiosk shows. Relative paths resolve from the folder that contains the catalog file.

title.description: Main heading at the top of every kiosk screen.

iconLight.description: Optional icon for the Light and GitHub Light themes. Use it when "icon" is a white logo that does not show on a light background.

folders.description: Top-level folders. The kiosk shows them in the 3D carousel, in this order.

icon.description: A Primer Octicon name (for example "infinity", "shield-check", "stack"; see https://primer.style/octicons) or a path or URL to an .svg, .png, .jpg, .jpeg, .gif, or .webp image.
Icon on the folder card. Default: "file-directory".

path.description: Path or http(s) URL of the video file (.mp4, .m4v, .webm, .mov, or .ogv).

captions.description: Optional path or URL of a WebVTT (.vtt) captions file.

thumbnail.description: Optional path or URL of a thumbnail image. If you omit it, the server makes one from the video (needs ffmpeg).

duration.description: Optional length in seconds. If you omit it, the server reads it from the file (needs ffprobe).
